doc.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014

title: Getting bit by the jazz bug at Tottenville High School
summary: A stage band concert in tenth grade on Staten Island inspires Thomas and his friend Mason Ashe; he borrows an alto sax and works his way into the stage band by senior year.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Yes, big time. Big time. Even before Hamilton, in high school is where I got bit by the jazz bug. And that happened, I actually know the moment. I know the moment it happened. It was at a Tottenville High School stage band concert. Mason Ashe, also a graduate of Hamilton class of ’85, he and I went to junior high school together in Staten Island, Dreyfus Junior High School, then we went to high school together. Because it was junior high school we actually went to ninth grade at Dreyfus. So we went to Tottenville in tenth grade. So at the end of our sophomore year in tenth grade, we attend this stage band concert. And they played some Spyro Gyra, they played some Basie, they played some Steely Dan, and it just blew us away. It blew us away. We loved it. The expression, the way the instruments seemed to talk and speak to each other and express emotions, I mean I might not have put it in those terms then, you know, it was just exciting. So at the end of the concert they were sitting there and Mason says, “I’ve got to pick up my guitar again.” Because he played guitar. And I said, “I’ve got to pick up something.” I’d never played. I mean I played recorder you know, in elementary school, but nothing else. So I decided to pick up the alto saxophone. So I borrowed an alto, a Selmer Bundy from school. I was fortunate to go to a high school that had a really strong music program so they had a closet that had all kinds of instruments. So I took an alto sax home and started to learn. And in my junior year I was in the concert band and the — let’s see, the concert band, that was the main band. And my goal was to get into the stage band that first inspired me. By my senior year I got into the stage band on alto, and also the symphonic band that played, I guess, light classics.
